mapper.select: SELECT FROM tn_search_recommend_keyword WHERE enabled = true AND (start_date IS NULL OR start_date <= #{today}) AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= #{today}) ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM tn_search_recommend_keyword ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tn_search_recommend_keyword (keyword, display_order, start_date, end_date, enabled, memo, created_at, created_ip, created_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{keyword}, #{displayOrder}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{enabled}, #{memo}, #{createdAt}, #{createdIp}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedAt})
